text: Coverage assessment saved in plans/template-transform-coverage.md. Next release scope: (1) exact domain/capability metadata and honest registry status, (2) qualified fsaverage/fsLR surface routes, starting 164k <-> 32k, (3) registration-fusion MNI-to-cortex projection plus explicit aligned ribbon sampling. Acceptance requires pinned upstream assets and independent Workbench/neuromaps numerical and visual evidence; lossy resampling is not invertible.
